reports.title: FTI Consulting Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Revenues of $1.013 Billion, With Growth Across All Five Business Segments

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is reaffirming its full year 2026 revenue guidance range of between $3.940 billion and $4.100 billion. The Company now estimates EPS for full year 2026 will range between $7.55 and $8.05, which compares to the prior range of between $8.70 and $9.30. The Company estimates Adjusted EPS will range between $9.50 and $10.00, which compares to the prior range of between $9.10 and $9.70. The variance between EPS and Adjusted EPS guidance for full year 2026 is related to the third and fourth quarter of 2026 special charges, which the Company estimates will be approximately $1.55, and an estimated $0.40 of Extraordinary Litigation-Related Expenses.
